applicants: Pietermaritzburg and Midlands Chamber of Business
ruling: NERSA ordered to redetermine 2024/25 electricity tariffs. Court declared NERSA approval unlawful and invalid.
background: Msunduzi implemented 13.32% increase after NERSA rejected proposed 15.5%. Historical disputes ongoing — tariff issues predated this ruling. Msunduzi threatened to sue NERSA in 2024 over response delays.
implication_for_billdog: Msunduzi 2024/25 electricity tariffs are under legal redetermination. Return UNKNOWN for all Msunduzi 2024/25 electricity verifications. High priority municipality for dispute opportunities once redetermination published.
